title: Fix multi-hunk offset drift and context mismatch check in diff applier
prompt:
Fix the bugs in `mini_patch/applier.py`:
1. When applying multiple hunks to the same file, earlier insertions/deletions shift line numbers for subsequent hunks, or you must compute positions relative to the original line indices.
2. Verify that every context (` `) and deletion (`-`) line in a hunk matches the target text; raise `ValueError` on mismatch.
3. Preserve whether the original text ended with a trailing newline unless the hunk changes the last line.
Run `pytest` to verify.
